examples.english: Ahmed is in front of the house and the door is closed.
examples.transliteration: ahmed oddam el beit wa el baab makfool

examples.arabic: رحت المحل لكن لقيت الباب مقفول
examples.english: I went to the shop but found the door closed.
examples.transliteration: Ro7t el ma7al laken la2eet el bab ma'fool.

examples.arabic: لكن لما صحينا الصبح لقينا الباب مقفول والمفتاح مش موجود
examples.english: But when we woke up in the morning, we found the door closed and the key missing!
examples.transliteration: Lakin lamma sihina el sobh le'ina el bab ma'fool wel moftah mish mawgoud!
